title: Colonel Blanchard announces a crashed flying saucer
place_text: Roswell Army Air Field, New Mexico

tellings.quote: so they said uh everybody was seeing UFOs. So, the uh base commander, who was a very well-liked fellow, very popular fellow named Colonel Blanchard, called up the newspaper and said um you know, "Look what we found. We found a crashed flying saucer."

plain: In 1947, at the Roswell Army Air Field in New Mexico, when everyone was seeing UFOs, the well-liked base commander, Colonel Blanchard, is said to have called the local newspaper and announced, "Look what we found. We found a crashed flying saucer." The physicist John Brandenburg tells it on the show, passing on what veterans of the Roswell base said. If true, the military itself once publicly announced recovering a flying saucer.
